== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Feiora Torannus is an Overlord and an Avernus Travelers{{!}}Avernus Traveler. Physically, she is characterized by a heavy jaw, dark eyes, very short hair, and a powerful presence. Unlike many others from her [[Territory]], she avoids traditional buckskin and feather attire, opting instead for simple black clothing accented by a bronze-and-pearl pin that signifies her status. She is accompanied by a silent raven named [[Eugan]], who has the ability to travel through [[Gates]] alongside her. Feiora holds a leadership role, stepping in to unify the [[Avernus Travelers]] when necessary and successfully rallying the [[Enosh Travelers]]. She possesses the ability to open [[Gates]], a skill that has assisted others such as [[Indirial]]. Throughout her experiences, she has been involved in conflicts involving various [[Incarnations]] and different groups of [[Travelers]], including the [[Damascan Tartarus Travelers]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Feiora Torannus wears a dark leather breastplate. Her protection also includes hardened leather covering her forearms and shins.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As an Overlord, she possesses the power to open a Gate. She is also capable of summoning a spear.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Feiora Torannus is an Overlord who maintains her own territory and travels with her raven, [[Eugan]]. Clad in a dark leather breastplate along with hardened leather protection on her forearms and shins, she concludes a discussion with [[Indirial]]. During her journey, she demonstrates the ability to summon a spear and possesses the power to open a Gate.}}
